title: settings.json
description: Jisuno settings. First run writes every key with its default. Hot-reloaded; on error the file is rejected and the last good config stays live.

$schema.description: Path of this schema as written under ~/.config/jisuno/schemas/.

model.description: Speech recognition model. v3 int8 is multilingual; v2 int8 is English-only.

model_load.description: When the model loads: on_demand starts loading at key-down and runs under speech; at_login loads at login.

unload_after_idle_min.description: Minutes without use before the model unloads; 0 means never.

input_device.description: Microphone: "system" is the system default input, otherwise a device name. A missing device falls back to the system input with a HUD note.

dictation_limit_s.description: Maximum dictation length in seconds (hands-free too); at the cap Jisuno stops and transcribes, as if released.

hands_free_silence_ms.description: Silence duration in milliseconds that ends a hands-free session.

partials.description: Show live partial transcripts in the HUD.

insert.description: How text is inserted: paste (with clipboard save/restore) or type (synthetic key events; fallback when the clipboard write fails).

insert_type_apps.description: Bundle ids of apps that always use typed insertion instead of paste.

restore_clipboard.description: Restore the clipboard contents after paste insertion.

hud.description: Where the HUD appears: at the notch, by the cursor, or off.
